build_distributed_experiment: build a Launchpad program for running a distributed RL experiment with actors and learners
build_learner: build the learning component of a JAX agent with replay and checkpointing support
build_inference_server: build an inference server for ActorCore policies with JIT-compiled batched action selection
build_actor: build an actor process that connects an environment to a policy network with replay adder
build_replay: build replay storage tables using the experiment builder and environment spec
